sources.label: SEC cybersecurity disclosure rule
sources.intervalBecause: A disclosure clock, where the harm from a missed amendment is a LATE FILING and is asymmetric — nobody is penalised for reading the rule too often. The operative text of these instruments is comparatively stable; the staff interpretation around them is not, and it is the interpretation that moves a deadline. 365 days would let a changed clock sit unnoticed for up to a year on the one artifact whose value is being on time. Halved to 180 on 2026-08-09.

sources.version: pending; no Commission action recorded as at 2026-08-09. A petition is not a proposal and not a rule — this row exists because the product now names it, and a claim about pendency decays the moment the Commission acts
